name: Tenue de cérémonie d’expédition
historicalBrief: Reeve Survive conserve cicatrices, âge et gabarit; veste sombre renforcée discrètement, veste ouverte au mouvement, outils rangés dans une trousse formelle.

supportPointQA.method: Read-only alpha segmentation of lowest8percent silhouette, equal weighting of separated boot intervals; lowest sole determines floor; retain far-foot perspective height difference.

prompt: Create exactly ONE finished 2D fighting-game character sprite on a completely transparent RGBA background. One full body only, isolated, entire head/hair, hands, all equipment and both boot soles fully inside the canvas with modest clear margins. Tall portrait canvas; character occupies about 87% of height. Right-facing three-quarter side view looking at the opponent to the right, grounded neutral combat-ready stance, no action sequence, no sprite sheet, no additional views, no text, no labels, no scenery, no glow cloud, no ground shadow, no rotation. Crisp detailed hand-painted/cel-shaded 2D game art with clean readable contours, natural anatomy and coherent mechanical detail. Use the attached identity reference ONLY for the appropriate same-period character, especially face, hairstyle, age, stature and defining equipment. The attachment contains multiple poses; choose its top-left standing figure as identity reference and render just one newly drawn figure. This is a NEW ORIGINAL CQC alternative costume, not an official Konami outfit and not a recovery of a lost image. REEVE, Metal Gear Survive incarnation only, adult rugged man with exact medium brown swept-back hair, angular weathered face, age, stubble and scars matching attached top-left standing figure. Costume OC-007 Tenue de cérémonie d’expédition: a deep navy-charcoal expedition-formal jacket with subtle reinforced shoulder seams and protected cuffs, open front permitting movement over a plain charcoal waistcoat and ivory shirt with a sober open neck; no bow tie, no business dinner tuxedo lapels. Tailored dark utility-formal trousers, polished but robust black boots. A neatly designed closed small formal leather tool case hangs at rear hip with secured wrench handles visible through organized loops; restrained expedition harness under the jacket. Preserve his actual age, broad practical build and scars, no beautification into a generic young man. Full body, hands relaxed neutral right-facing ready stance. Functional ceremonial field clothing rather than old generic navy bow-tie tuxedo.
limits: New authored interpretation of the pre-established ORIGINAL CQC costume brief; not an official alternative costume.
Faithfulness of identity is based on physically viewed preserved CQC incarnation references; no pixel-perfect Konami model certification.
No left-facing draw, animation continuity, hitboxes or playable admission delivered by this source.
